recommendations.title: Document idempotency guarantees for random_seed
recommendations.problem: random_seed parameter documented as supporting reproducibility but no explicit statement on whether same seed guarantees identical output across runs
recommendations.root_cause: Agent-specific idempotency criterion expects clear determinism statement
recommendations.fix: Add note after random_seed documentation: 'Given identical sequence, num_tokens, temperature, top_k, top_p, and random_seed, generation is deterministic and will produce the same output across runs. For non-deterministic sampling, omit random_seed or vary it.'

recommendations.title: Add retry logic for transient network failures
recommendations.problem: No guidance on handling transient 503 or timeout errors during generation or forward passes
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes network reliability; long-running generation requests may time out
recommendations.fix: Add to Troubleshooting section: 'For timeout errors on long sequences, increase requests timeout parameter or reduce num_tokens. For transient 503 errors, retry with exponential backoff (wait 2s, 4s, 8s between attempts).'

recommendations.title: Consolidate escape hatches in dedicated section
recommendations.problem: When-not-to-use guidance scattered across troubleshooting; no explicit out-of-scope section
recommendations.root_cause: Escape hatch criterion expects consolidated 'When NOT to use' guidance
recommendations.fix: Add section before 'Choose Mode': 'When NOT to use: For RNA or protein sequence generation use appropriate models; for sequences >10k bases expect longer inference times; for A100 GPUs use hosted mode or switch to supported FP8 hardware.'
